review: Found this place by accident and I'm so glad I did. The oat milk latte was perfectly smooth and the barista took the time to chat about the beans. Already planning to come back this weekend!
Cozy spot with great lighting for working. Wi-Fi is fast, outlets at most tables, and the blueberry scone was still warm. I stayed three hours and nobody rushed me.
Waited 25 minutes for a single cold latte. When I asked about it, the guy at the counter just shrugged and rolled his eyes. Won't be coming back.
The croissant was stale and tasted like it had been sitting out since yesterday. The tables were also sticky. For $6 I expected much better.
Terrible. I'm allergic to nuts and told them clearly, but my drink came with almond milk. I had to throw it out. Please train your staff!!
Coffee is honestly some of the best in town, but the place is tiny and so loud I couldn't hear my friend across the table. Great for takeaway, not for catching up.
Oh wow, what a *relaxing* 20 minute wait for a drip coffee. The mug was cute though.
It's a cafe. They serve coffee. Nothing special but nothing wrong either.
